evals.prompt: Run reflect-setup over the committed semantic corpus (fixtures/evaluation/semantic) and reconcile the two sessions that describe the same patch-context failure under different proposed keys. Expect exactly one final candidate containing both finding IDs and both evidence references.
evals.expected_output: One final candidate cluster for the patch-context failure that merges the two synonym-named findings, with both finding IDs in the reconciliation partition and both original evidence references preserved.

expectations.name: synonym-merge-single-candidate
expectations.text: The final ranked candidates contain exactly one cluster for the patch-context failure.

expectations.name: synonym-merge-both-findings
expectations.text: The merged candidate contains both finding IDs from the two sessions.

expectations.name: synonym-merge-both-evidence
expectations.text: The merged candidate preserves both original evidence references.

evals.prompt: Run reflect-setup over the committed semantic corpus (fixtures/evaluation/semantic) where two sessions share a generic build-failure symptom but the supplied paraphrases identify different causes. Expect two separate candidates and a complete one-to-one reconciliation partition.
evals.expected_output: Two final candidates (missing dependency, stale build cache) with a complete one-to-one reconciliation partition that never merges the two different causes.

expectations.name: cause-preservation-two-candidates
expectations.text: The final ranked candidates contain two separate clusters for the two different build-failure causes.

expectations.name: cause-preservation-partition
expectations.text: The reconciliation partition is complete and one-to-one: every finding ID appears exactly once.

evals.prompt: Run reflect-setup with --apply and a host input that approves one fixture cluster with request and workspace inputs but no proof. Expect the run to stop at apply-preview with a bounded preview and byte-identical target files before and after the run.
evals.expected_output: The run reports stage apply-preview, creates a bounded preview for the approved cluster, and never modifies the target project files.

expectations.name: preview-only-stage
expectations.text: The run stops at apply-preview and never reaches apply-validated without a proof.

expectations.name: preview-only-bounded
expectations.text: The preview is bounded to the approved target paths and commands.

expectations.name: preview-only-no-execution
expectations.text: Target project files are byte-identical before and after the run.
